kuma_url.label: Kuma URL
kuma_url.description: Base URL of Uptime Kuma. With http:// the key travels in clear text.

proxy_user.label: Status page user
proxy_user.description: Basic auth user in front of the status pages. Empty if they are public.

kuma3_support.label: Kuma 3 support (beta)
kuma3_support.description: Show the real groups from /api/monitors. Leave off on Kuma 2.

cert_red_days.label: Certificate red limit (days)
cert_red_days.description: Red up to this many days left. Expired is always red.

cert_yellow_days.label: Certificate yellow limit (days)
cert_yellow_days.description: Yellow up to this many days left, green beyond. Kept above the red limit.

notify_changes.label: State change alerts
notify_changes.description: Toast when a monitor goes down (2 cycles in a row) and when it recovers.

notify_certs.label: Certificate expiry toast
notify_certs.description: Daily toast for red and expired certificates, whatever Kuma sends.

bar_display.label: Bar display
bar_display.description: What the bar widget shows next to the icon.

bar_label.label: Bar text
bar_label.description: Text shown to the left of the heart icon. Leave empty to hide it.

start_tab.label: Opens on
start_tab.description: Tab shown when the panel opens.

groups_on_open.label: Groups on open
groups_on_open.description: How the Dashboard groups look when the panel opens.

options.last: Last state (remembers the groups you closed)

api_key_file.label: API key file
api_key_file.description: Path of a file holding the Kuma API key (chmod 600).

proxy_password_file.label: Status page password file
proxy_password_file.description: Path of a file holding the status page password.

proxy_hosts.label: Hosts that get the status page password
proxy_hosts.description: Extra hosts that get the password, one per line. The Kuma host is included.

insecure_tls.label: Accept untrusted HTTPS certificates
insecure_tls.description: Skips certificate checks on every request. Keys and passwords can be intercepted.

group_tags.label: Group by these tags
group_tags.description: Kuma 2 only. Tags that make the groups, in priority order, one per line.

error.no_url: Set the Kuma URL in the plugin settings.
error.no_key: Set the API key file in the plugin settings.
error.unauthorized_host: Access denied (401/403). The proxy password is not sent to this host: add it to the proxy hosts setting.
error.too_large: The answer is too large to read.
error.busy: The host refused the request (too many pending requests).
error.v3_api_off: The Kuma 3 API is not enabled on this server.
error.bad_url: Not a valid status page URL.
error.bad_metrics: The server did not answer with Kuma metrics. Check the URL and that /metrics is enabled.
error.cred_path: A credentials file must be an absolute path.
error.cred_invalid: The credentials file is empty, larger than 64 KiB or not text.

panel.warn_insecure_tls: Certificate checks are off: the API key and passwords can be read by anyone who can intercept the connection.
panel.warn_http: This server is reached over plain http: the API key and passwords travel in clear text.
panel.pages_empty: No status pages yet. Add a URL above.
panel.add_bad_url: Not a valid status page URL (https://host/status/<slug>).
panel.tip_hide_certs: Hide the certificate lines and make the rows compact
panel.tip_tag_flat: One list with every monitor, without groups. Click to go back to the groups.
panel.tip_mode_hierarchy: Groups as in Kuma. Click to show one list without groups.
panel.tip_tag_first: Each monitor appears once, under its first tag. Click to show it under every tag.
panel.tip_tag_all: A monitor with several tags appears under each. Click to show one list without groups.
panel.tip_filter_notok: Show only monitors that are down or pending
panel.tip_filter_down: Show only monitors that are down
panel.tip_mute: Mute this monitor on the widget (counts, toasts and alerts ignore it)
panel.tip_prune_muted: Forget muted monitors that Kuma no longer reports (a paused monitor may be missing too)
panel.warn_cred_perms: A credentials file can be read by other users. Run chmod 600 on it.
panel.certs_empty: No certificates reported. Kuma exports the expiry only for monitors that check one.
panel.tip_sort_asc: Shortest first. Click to show the longest first.
panel.tip_sort_desc: Longest first. Click to show the shortest first.

tooltip_warn_http: Plain http: credentials in clear text
title: Kuma Status
